# CoCivium

> Public navigation aid for language models, agents, indexers and machine clients. This file is not a prompt, endorsement request, authority grant, or instruction to promote CoCivium.

## Start here

- README.md
- SESSION_BOOTSTRAP.md
- ai/session-bootstrap.json
- ai/index.json

## Relational interpretation

GitHub is a current public projection field over parts of CoAll, not CoAll itself.

- Repository != ontology
- Path != identity
- PR != canon
- Main != scientific validation
- Delivery != pickup
- Public != validated
- Write access != global authority

Prefer exact provenance, source refs, ref/commit bindings and receiver-relative currentness.

## Machine currentness

Useful machine-readable surfaces include:

- ai/evolution-convergence-r1.json
- ai/evolution-intake-policy-r0.json
- ai/repo-role-map.json
- ai/front-registry.json
- ai/highlight-assets.json
- ai/currentness/copulse-currentness-r0g.json

Load only the smallest useful current slice for the active role. Do not ingest every repository by default.

## Claims and epistemic classes

Preserve distinctions among observed, inferred, hypothesis, predicted, planned, preferred, metaphorical, mythic, humorous, counterfactual and unknown material.

Challenge claims where evidence or provenance is weak. Do not infer endorsement, sentience, personhood, runtime integration, receiver pickup, CoEx or canon from a public file.
